chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, who said:
I saw Abu Ja'far عليه السلام — or he said: I heard him — begin the salat (prayer) with seven takbirs in succession.

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja'far, the Imam عليه السلام mentioned in the report

ai.seo_question: How did Abu Ja'far عليه السلام begin the salat (prayer) according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abu Ja'far عليه السلام began the salat (prayer) with seven takbirs said consecutively. It relates to the manner and description of salat (prayer), indicating a transmitted practice concerning its opening.
